title: receipts (and docs) added in the freeze commit itself
shortcut: The bytes of CTL-C1-3 are committed together with the frozen carriers.json, counter, predicate and oracle, i.e. the after.json first appears in the freeze commit, not in a commit that descends from it. Everything else is identical and green.

commits: round-39 freeze (CTL-C1-5): counter, predicate, carriers, oracle, receipts, docs

expected.refusing_binding: first add of every after.json MUST be a commit that strictly descends from the freeze (add_commit != freeze and freeze is an ancestor of add_commit)
expected.per_carrier: subject pin, handler, files, gaps, evidence id and every documentation binding pass at the freeze revision; only the strict-descendant rule refuses
expected.isolates: ancestry strictness; a counter that tests merge-base --is-ancestor freeze add_commit without add_commit != freeze returns 0 for the freeze commit and passes this control
expected.note: a stronger sibling variant commits the receipts in the freeze's parent commit; it defeats a strict-descendant check only if the counter does not also require freeze < add_commit

defeat_risk: medium-high - ancestry checks are usually written non-strict
